package_type: Merge b17 native-PAXI+v6 base with b14 camera-B tap/CAM_SEL=1; sim (B geometry, 16-word native, P1 three goldens, drop-R/retry, v6); 1 Routed candidate + 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; 1 SRAM download then COM8 150 s.

decision_basis.b14_r1: B live on board: cap 4,470, pix/line/crop exact, CAM_SEL=bit12=1, Routed +0.110/0 violations; but no PAXI fix -> timeout 13,410 / retry 8,940 / giveup 4,470, enc 0, exported 0
decision_basis.b17_r0: native PAXI repair offline all-PASS: 16/16 word readback (addr 0/8/16...), wstrb=0, two full frames four-CRC+zlib, P1 three goldens, v6 273 B; Routed +0.002
decision_basis.b17_r1: 1 bitgen + 1 CWC from the frozen r0 routed DB (bit 20AC69F5...7DFFA); board blocked at FTDI preflight, 0 downloads
decision_basis.chosen: single merged candidate: b17 base (PAXI/v6/R1 retry) + b14 B tap/CAM_SEL=1/B SDC
rejected: reuse b14 r1 bit (no PAXI fix -> giveup)
reuse b17 r1 bit (A-only top, no B tap)
relax SDC or seed to buy timing

round_accounting.T10.b14-cam-b: closed FAIL (export gate); no rounds inherited
round_accounting.T10.b17-paxi-native: closed blocked at board preflight; no rounds inherited
round_accounting.T10.b18-b17-b: new independent task; round0 first acceptance by a new integrated tester; repair rounds 1-3 only for real same-candidate failures
round_accounting.T10: blocked (board closure of the A+ export loop still outstanding)

frozen.shared_six_identical: a1_ddr_arb2.v, a1_ddr_slot_store.v, a1_deflate_core.v, a1_frame_top.v, a1_raw_crop.v, cam_diag_mailbox.v are byte-identical in b14 and b17; copy from ../T10.b17-paxi-native/r0/changed-src/ and record the full SHA256 in the candidate manifest

allowed_change.scope: b17 base keeps PAXI/v6/R1 retry byte-identical; b14 overlay is exactly the B tap and CAM_SEL select; no other RTL/SDC/ADC change; no false path, multicycle, clock merge, frequency or seed change

gates.merge: C01-C18 in merge-spec.md §3 all pass; 6 shared files byte-identical; SDC/ADC hash-equal
gates.sim: T1 pix_beats 2,117,472 / line 2,192 / frame 1 / raw_len 2,592,000 / enc=1 / exported=1 / four CRC+zlib; T2 16/16 readback, wstrb=0; T3 P1 three goldens byte-identical; T4 drop-R retry exports, no deadlock; T5 273/6/67, field #13 bit12=1, diag_flags bits1..5=0; vlog Errors:0
gates.synth: <=3 attempts, SWNS >= 0, TNS >= 0, 0 violations, ERAM + CWC <= 300
gates.route: <=2 attempts, 0 violated endpoints, hold >= 0, period positive; WNS >= +0.05 target; +0.003..<+0.05 only as diagnostic candidate with timing_caveat; < +0.003 or any violation -> stop
gates.bit: 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; fail-closed STA re-check; bit/CWC/BID hashes; cw/compiled.* byte-identical; <phy_eram> present, no incomplete <logic_eram/>
gates.board: FTDI preflight first; download FIRST then COM8 150 s; CAM_SEL bit12=1; 273/6/67, bad_xor=0, 150 packets; timeout/retry/giveup deltas 0; enc>0; exported>0; >=1 frame four CRCs+zlib; no half frame; raw_drop/raw_abort not growing
gates.board_fail: if giveup still grows: keep v6 timeout_ar_addr/low3 + last_issued_ar_addr + diag_flags + inflight_state and stop; no second download/capture/Flash

hardware.preflight: Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly match VID_0403&PID_6042 and HKLM SERIALCOMM COM8; absent -> board=blocked, 0 downloads, 0 COM8
hardware.order: SRAM download with COM8 closed -> close JTAG/hwserver -> open COM8 150 s
hardware.release: close COM8 before any further JTAG interaction; no second download

path_contract.td: T: = T10.b18-b17-b/r0/td, Y: = D:\fpga\ph1p100; never map X: to the project root; run tools/td/td_env.ps1 first

stop_rule: C-check failure after 2 attempts; sim gate failure; 3 synth below target; 2 route still violated or < +0.003; bitgen/CWC failure; board giveup still growing; budget exhausted -> stop and return to the original planner. No second download, no Flash, no SDC/clock/seed change, no batch delete.

tester.role: new independent integrated tester (not the developer)
